Fortress 2.5Ltr Light Grey Anti Slip Decking Stain delivers durable protection and an attractive finish for exterior timber decking. This water-based formula nourishes wood, providing essential resistance against water and UV damage. Ideal for garden decks and pathways, its anti-slip properties ensure a safer outdoor surface for commercial or domestic settings. The stain is quick-drying, touch-dry in two hours and recoatable within four, allowing efficient completion of projects. A single 2.5Ltr tub covers up to 25 square metres, making it a practical choice for trade professionals seeking a robust, long-lasting light grey decking solution.
